== Biography ==
'''Robert de Glasgu''' was a clerk in the household of Gilbert, bishop of Dunkeld, between 1229 and 1236. He appears in the expanded witness list of a charter preserved in a 1423 transumpt.<ref>D. E. Easson and Angus Macdonald, eds., ''Charters of the Abbey of Inchcolm'' (Edinburgh, 1938), no. 14, pp. 12–13 and 119–121; [https://deriv.nls.uk/dcn23/1283/0085/128300859.23.pdf National Library of Scotland].</ref>

The transumpt preserves usable evidence but is not a contemporary autograph. The charter names Robert among Bishop Gilbert's clerks and gives no family relationship.

== Research Notes ==
The Durham witness of 1248/49 could be the same man, but no shared office, benefice, patron or associate proves continuity. Keep them as separate working identities.
